rationale.complete: Round 1 done: pre-registration, synthetic validation (axis F) with dated amendments, 17 per-period verdicts plus NE41, C1 ground truth, post-hoc robustness labelled, scorecard and a dry-run confirmatory script (not run). Round 2 must decompose the nudge lag and replace the mention response.
rationale.faithfulness: The read-out gating (C9) beats a pseudo-message null and an other-room placebo in regimes II/III, and the synthetic common cause cannot produce it; NE41 is consistent in sign across 9 periods. But HH92's zero-parameter kernel fails for nudges (a constant delay fits as well), the talk clause fails in every regime-I/II period, ground truth covers one atypical agent, and nothing has been confirmed on the holdout.
rationale.usefulness: Gives an operator concrete, computable facts: reactions wait for the next model call (so coupling delay = call cadence), compaction cuts about a fifth of conversational coupling, nudges take about 5 min to act, and fetch logs can reveal silent exposure failures (the Claude Code replay). Modest novelty, since the gating follows from scaffold design; no validated control knob.

one_line: Responses wait for the next model call (10/11 periods); nudges lag read-out ~3 min; erasure cuts coupling 18%
